# Interface: IndexConfig

## Properties[​](#properties "Direct link to Properties")

### auth?[​](#auth "Direct link to auth?")

```ts
optional auth: "service-principal" | "on-behalf-of-user";

```

Auth mode for the built-in HTTP routes — "service-principal" (default) uses the app's SP, "on-behalf-of-user" proxies the logged-in user's token. Programmatic callers select per call via `appkit.aiSearch.asUser(req)`.

***

### columns?[​](#columns "Direct link to columns?")

```ts
optional columns: string[];

```

Columns to return in results. Optional: in development the plugin auto-discovers them from the index's source table when omitted (and warns that they should be set explicitly for production).

***

### embeddingFn()?[​](#embeddingfn "Direct link to embeddingFn()?")

```ts
optional embeddingFn: (text: string) => Promise<number[]>;

```

For self-managed embedding indexes: converts query text to an embedding vector. When provided, the plugin calls this function and sends query\_vector to VS. When omitted, query\_text is sent and VS computes embeddings server-side (managed mode).

#### Parameters[​](#parameters "Direct link to Parameters")

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `text`    | `string` |

#### Returns[​](#returns "Direct link to Returns")

`Promise`<`number`\[]>

***

### endpointName?[​](#endpointname "Direct link to endpointName?")

```ts
optional endpointName: string;

```

VS endpoint name (required when pagination is true)

***

### indexName?[​](#indexname "Direct link to indexName?")

```ts
optional indexName: string;

```

Three-level UC name: catalog.schema.index\_name. Defaults to the `DATABRICKS_VS_INDEX_NAME` env var when omitted — so multiple aliases that omit it all resolve to that same physical index. Set it explicitly per alias when they should point at distinct indexes.

***

### numResults?[​](#numresults "Direct link to numResults?")

```ts
optional numResults: number;

```

Max results per query

***

### pagination?[​](#pagination "Direct link to pagination?")

```ts
optional pagination: boolean;

```

Enable cursor pagination

***

### queryType?[​](#querytype "Direct link to queryType?")

```ts
optional queryType: SearchQueryType;

```

Default search mode

***

### reranker?[​](#reranker "Direct link to reranker?")

```ts
optional reranker: boolean | RerankerConfig;

```

Enable built-in reranker. Pass true to rerank all non-id columns, or an object for fine control.
